verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a single line in the Postman CLI overview saying the CLI can create, manage, and forward webhooks for event-driven integrations. That is a first-party webhook capability, but it is unclear whether it lets a consumer register callbacks for Postman's own events or mainly forwards inbound webhooks for local development. Missing for 10: documented event types a consumer can subscribe to, registration and delivery details (payloads, retries, signing), and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Create, manage, and forward webhooks for event-driven integrations and local development.
